features.body: The design describes contact preferences and sensitivity flags alongside each lead. No source-contact request is processed here.
features.title: Source preferences stay visible

features.body: The concept compares public interest, verifiability, source context, and urgency while leaving editorial decisions with people.
features.title: Give editors the signal

features.body: Evidence, place, beat, and source-safety context are shown together in the design concept, not linked to live newsroom data.
features.title: Keep the context together

hero.body: Leed is designed to turn audience submissions into concise story briefs and help editors route leads by beat and geography, with source contact preferences kept in view.
hero.headline: Bring reader tips into the newsroom story desk.
hero.note: Design concept only. No live tips, newsroom accounts, or routing connections.
